stem: Which situation best represents association but NOT causation?

options.label: A
options.text: When the number of spectators at a football game increases, the number of wins for the home team increases.

options.label: B
options.text: When more gallons of water are put into an aquarium, the weight of the aquarium increases.

options.label: C
options.text: When the amount of time an athlete runs increases, the distance she runs increases.

options.label: D
options.text: When the charge of a cell phone battery increases, the number of minutes the phone can be used increases.
